value.rationale: A global orbit statistic displays exact dependence localized at the left boundary of the one-line word, with four distinct conditioning regimes and a nonzero 1/4 limiting covariance. The result gives a sharp full n,k structural dependence classification not obtainable from the unconditional Eulerian marginals.

final_claim: For uniform Pi in S_n, n>=3, K the length of cycle containing 1, each one-line descent D_i for i>=2 is individually independent of K and fair. The conditional probability of D_1 is 0 for k=1, (n+1)/(2(n-1)) for k=2, n/(2(n-1)) for 3<=k<n, and 1/2 for k=n. Cov(K,D)=Cov(K,D_1)=(n^2-3n+4)/(4n(n-1)).
